Journal article / MOO-CAT-014

Moral Proximity: Ethics as Method in Post-Interpretive Criticism

Dorian Vale

2026Deposited editionSource-linked record

An essay developing moral proximity as a method of critical responsibility. It considers the relation between descriptive restraint, custodianship, and encounters with works concerned with trauma or absence.
